This '''individual ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Waiter/Legends|server]] who worked at a [[Unidentified club (Ryvester)|club]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryvester]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" /> In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]]. This event occurred during a flashback set in [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].</ref> he delivered a large gray [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]] box to the table where [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kosh Teradoc]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Hachat, who was secretly [[Garik Loran]] of [[Wraith Squadron]] in disguise, were meeting. After Hachat tipped him with a [[credcoin]], the server departed. The box contained a gemstone statuette that Hachat was using to convince Teradoc of the existence of a treasure hidden within [[The Palace of Piethet Brighteyes]].<ref name="Mercy Kill" />  

He wore the club's loose-fitting [[Color/Legends|blue]] and cream pantsuit uniform.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
